feature_contract.goal: Keep a complete native 4:3 or letterboxed 16:9/21:9 main-menu selection scene at its authored physical aspect and original optical position through partial Desktop Duplication capture, Reset and window relocation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only front-end menu LOCAL theater UV and optical fragment planning, not F11, gameplay HUD, world stereo, input, SkyGlow, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Original OutRun 4:3 menu and vehicle-selection sprites are letterboxed by UI settings on the game client.
Desktop Duplication reports the visible intersection as cropped UV, while R23 host PlanVisibleCenteredContent reconstructs the authored content rectangle.
R23 host fixes one optical clip and shared UV for both OpenXR eyes; invalid or fully restored capture uses conservative source fallback.
subcomponents: Native 4:3 partial-capture placement/extent relative to the full uncropped client with correct left/top/right optical offsets.
Unchanged authored letterboxed 16:9, ultrawide and portrait crop plus full-visibility/recenter/stale-UV fallback.
Deterministic native C++ smoke and destructive source-guard mutation in GitHub Windows policy test.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native 4:3 menus retain full authored optical scale/center while clipped left, top or right fragments occupy exactly the original partial quad.
4:3/16:9/21:9 and portrait letterboxed crops remain unchanged; restored fully visible 4:3 and invalid/stale UV have no fragment override.
Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active complete Win32 game/host/package plus Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact required gates succeed before build-verified status.

diagnosis.original_evidence: main_r23.cpp calls PlanVisibleCenteredContent for user letterboxed menu; original helper exits on !fullPlan.crop even when original 4:3 client is partially outside the capture output.
diagnosis.root_cause: Native 4:3 originalAspect == intendedAspect causes PlanCenteredContent to return crop=false and skips R23 visibleOffset/visibleScale optical fragment path; sampled fragment is projected full-size at the center.
source_trace: Original menu 4:3 sprites and front-end UI scaling produce authored client rectangle.
GetGameUv samples only clipped Desktop Duplication intersection; PlanVisibleCenteredContent decides crop and fragment geometry.
R23 LOCAL menu projects the reconstructed clip and source UV identically to both OpenXR eye slices.
alternatives_rejected: Correcting PlanCapturedAspect alone would change apparent ratio but still center a partial native 4:3 image at full scale.
Changing per-eye projection/view matrix risks asymmetric FOV stereo and cannot recover original client-space clipping.
Removing cropping globally would regress existing 21:9 sidebars, portrait matte and source geometry.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Retain full native client optical geometry and permit a fragment plan only when UV proves output edge intersection; keep fully visible native 4:3 no-crop.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Three native 4:3 left/top/right clipped C++ fixtures fail on old early-return path, plus fully restored and stale-UV controls and three destructive source guard mutants.
